title: THE OBSIDIAN INDEX
styleDirection: An original 1990s DOS VGA archaeological mystery. Compose directly for a 320 by 200 logical screen with a 320 by 160 gameplay viewport above a persistent 40-pixel verb panel. Use deep blue-violet archive shadows, restrained warm lamp highlights, readable stone and paper materials, strong actor silhouettes, project-owned indexed palettes, deliberate pixel clusters and material-specific dithering. It studies reusable production grammar only and must not reproduce a commercial character, room, logo, dialogue line, interface drawing, map or puzzle solution.

promptFragments: retain the exact 40-pixel interface reservation and the approved room palette family
the room must be composed for the final native grid rather than painted at arbitrary scale and reduced later
test the actor at native size against archive, harbour and observatory room palettes

referenceContract.continuityAuthority: Approved project-owned style proof, room palette, character identity master, adjacent animation cels and interface geometry for the same production family.

metadata.purpose: Original cross-repository proof for Adventure Studio, Art Studio and Godot Game Test Lab.
